Aipas M1 Max Xterrain ST eBike Overview
The Aipas M1 Max Xterrain ST eBike is the step-through comfort-control model in the Aipas off-road electric bikes lineup. It is built for riders who want easier mounting, strong motor support, and smoother handling on steep hills, forest paths, rough roads, and long mixed-surface routes.
Its 26×4 puncture-resistant fat tires also connect the M1 Max to the Aipas fat tire ebikes collection by adding traction, balance, and comfort across dirt, sand, snow, gravel, and uneven surfaces.

Off-Road Role: This motor and torque setup helps define the M1 Max’s role in the Aipas off-road electric bikes lineup, supporting steep hills, rugged terrain, and demanding trails with stronger acceleration and control.
Pair it with the Brushless Motor Controller for optimized performance and smooth power delivery.

2. Stable Aluminum Alloy Frame
Frame Role: The step-through frame positions the M1 Max as the easier-access comfort model within the Aipas off-road lineup.
Durability: Built to support demanding routes while maintaining comfort and long-term stability.
Design: Sleek, sturdy, and engineered for balanced handling across rough roads, mixed surfaces, and daily riding conditions.

Charging: Flexible dual-mode charging — built-in waterproof battery charging and removable charging.
Ride Support: Helps the M1 Max cover longer mixed-surface rides, weekend routes, and daily travel without limiting it to short trips.

Comfort-Control Role: The front suspension and rear air shock are the clearest reasons the M1 Max is positioned as the step-through comfort-control model in the Aipas off-road electric bikes lineup.
Benefit: Reduces vibrations and bumps for smoother, more controlled riding on forest paths, rough roads, rocky paths, and uneven ground.
Enhance your comfort further with the Suspension Seatpost.

Control: Offers precise, consistent stopping power for heavier fat tire setups, rough roads, changing weather, and uneven riding conditions.

Fat Tire Role: This 26×4 tire setup also connects the M1 Max to the Aipas fat tire ebikes collection.
Surface Fit: Adds traction, balance, and comfort across dirt, sand, snow, gravel, rough roads, and mixed surfaces.

7. Smart LCD Display
Functions: Shows real-time speed, battery level, mileage, and pedal assist levels
Extras: Built-in USB charging port keeps your phone powered while using a Phone Mount for navigation.

Transmission: Shimano 7-speed gear system for adaptable riding across city streets, rough roads, and mixed routes.

9. Easy Assembly
Setup: 90% pre-assembled with the front wheel installed for quick setup and ready-to-ride convenience.

Summary
The Aipas M1 Max Xterrain ST eBike is best understood as the step-through comfort-control model within the Aipas off-road electric bikes lineup. Its 1800W motor, 110Nm torque, front suspension, rear air shock, and dual disc brakes define its off-road role for riders who want power, easier access, and smoother handling on rough or changing surfaces.
Its 26×4 fat tires give the M1 Max a secondary connection to the Aipas fat tire ebikes collection, adding traction and comfort on dirt, sand, snow, gravel, rough roads, and mixed surfaces. For riders comparing Aipas Xterrain models, the M1 Max offers easier step-through access with upgraded comfort, while M1 Pro is the simpler step-through option and M2 Max provides a step-over comfort-control setup.
For an enhanced riding experience, explore related gear like the Lighted Cycling Helmet and Cube Electric Air Pump to stay visible, prepared, and ready for changing routes.
